bullets: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: exclude legacy AssemblyInfo.cs from copied sources so SDK-generated assembly attributes don't collide (fixes CS0579 duplicate-attribute build breaks that recur on any UWP->WinUI 3 migration).
